maps.title: GTA 6 Interactive Map: Leonida's Counties, Cities and Islands
maps.seo_title: GTA 6 Map of Leonida: Counties, Vice City, Islands and Keys
maps.meta_description: Find Vice City, Port Gellhorn, Mount Kalaga National Park and the Key Lento keys on GTA 6's Leonida map, plus all five counties and the islands around them.
maps.intro_md:
GTA 6's map covers Leonida, the fictional state the game is set in. Leonida has five counties: Vice-Dale, Mariana, Kelly, Leonard and Lummox. Vice City is the main city, on the east side, and the airport lies to its west.

Everything else in Leonida fills in around it: towns and parks, lakes and swamps, and a long run of islands and keys along the coasts and the southern edge.
maps.description_md:
## Where the Five Counties Sit in GTA 6

Vice-Dale is the eastern county. Vice City, Vice Beach and the airport all sit inside it. Mariana runs across the south-west, and Mile Zero Air Station, Key Lento, Southwind and Capri all fall within its borders.

Lummox takes the north, and Mount Kalaga National Park, Millport, Grayson and Bonanza all lie within it. Leonard sits in the north-east, and Richard Barebone State Park, Waning Sands and Lake Leonida are all inside it. Kelly is the west-central county, and Buckskin Swamp and Port Gellhorn both fall inside it.

How big Leonida is next to other maps is covered in the [map size comparison](/articles/gta-6-map-size-compared).

## Cities, Towns and Named Areas Across Leonida

Vice Beach is a beach area on the east coast, in Vice-Dale County. Ocean Beach and Washington Beach are part of it. Port Vice City is the port on the city's east side. Hamlet sits in Vice-Dale County, close to the Hamlet Correctional Institution.

Up north, Bonanza has bays and islands close by, plus the Moreau River. The Featherstone Islands and San Malo Bay are both near Grayson. The Millport Basin is close to Millport.

Ambrosia is a town in the middle of the state, and the Allied Crystal sugar refinery there provides jobs. Belville sits in Leonard County, and it's south-east of Lake Leonida. Frontier Adventure Golf and the Leith River are both inside Waning Sands, which is in Leonard County.

On the west coast, Port Gellhorn is a Kelly County town that was once a vacation destination. Its motels are cheap, its attractions are closed, and its strip malls sit empty. Gellhorn sits in South Kelly County, with Gellhorn Raceway just to its west. Further south on the same coast, Capri sits in Mariana County and has Tortoise Lake inside it. Capri Sound is nearby.

In the south, Watson Bay is a Mariana County area with a ShoreFront bank job, one of the bank robberies you can pull in Leonida. Southwind has Permit Keys nearby. Key Lento has Gambit Bay nearby. Grassrivers is a wetland full of mangroves and alligators.

## Vice City's Districts and Neighborhoods

Downtown has Fleeca, Lombank and ShoreFront bank jobs. The full [bank jobs list](/wiki/gta-6/bank-jobs) covers them.

Rockridge has a ShoreFront bank job, Bayside has a Lombank one, and Tequesta has a Fleeca one. The Pegassi Residences building and Tequesta Retreat are both inside Tequesta. Peacock Bay, a bay inside Vice City, has Fleeca and Lombank jobs too.

Yasmani has a shop in Little Cuba, and Tyrone has an apartment in La Perle. They're fences, the buyers who pay you for stolen goods, and both show up on the [fences list](/wiki/gta-6/fences).

Salton lies just west of Little Cuba. Crosstown is a neighborhood north of Downtown, east of Rockridge. Southside is south-west of Downtown.

Decor District sits north-east of the city, with Stockyard just below it. Leaf Links is a Vice City area, and the Leaf Links Golf Challenge is held at an exclusive golf club there.

## Airport, Parks and Landmarks to Find

Vice City's airport is known as VCIA. Breakwater Quarry sits west of it, near the Nehrling River.

Mile Zero Air Station is an air base in Mariana County, and military tanks and jets are on site. Mount Kalaga National Park sits on Leonida's northern border. It has hunting, fishing and off-road trails.

Richard Barebone State Park sits north-east of Lake Leonida, on the north-east coast. Emerald Springs is an area north of Buckskin Swamp, in Kelly County, beside the Emerald River.

## Islands and Keys Off Leonida's Coasts

Starfish Island sits off Vice City's east side, and it's where a swim ends. The Tequesta Swim challenge asks you to swim from Tequesta Retreat to Starfish Island in under 15 minutes. The Rialto Islands sit north of Starfish Island.

Dalton Island has a ferry terminal. Ride from it for $50 and you fast-travel to Waxman Island.

Catalan Key and Gloriana Key are both keys inside Vice City. A gated community sits just south of Catalan Key, and an abandoned stadium stands in the built-up south end of Gloriana Key.

Corsair Key sits in the Key Lento area and has a Triangler Sculpture on it. Shoeless Keys is a group of keys in Mariana County, in the Key Lento area. The Riquezas Keys are a group of keys on the north-west side of Mile Zero Air Station. Abismo Key sits east of the air station, in the southern keys.

Little Hardin Island lies off the north-east coast, to the east of Richard Barebone State Park. Hyde Island sits north-east of Bonanza, off the northern coast.

On the west side, Draper Island sits north-west of Port Gellhorn, in Kelly County. Draper Bay is right beside it. The Zephyr Islands are a group off the north-west coast, just west of Mount Kalaga National Park. Sandbars and Crude Islands are off the west coast, west and south-west of Port Gellhorn. Belpoint is an island just off Capri's west coast.

## Lakes, Swamps, Bays and Open Water

Lake Leonida sits north-east of Ambrosia, in North Leonard County. Buckskin Swamp is a swampy stretch in South Kelly County, lying east of Gellhorn. Pelican Valley is a swampy spot in Mariana County. Inside it you'll find a river, a marsh, a bay and a lake.

The Atlantic Ocean runs along Leonida's east edge, above Vice Beach. The Gulf of Leonida is open water south-west of Capri.

Leonida Bay sits north of the Southwind keys. Below the Southwind keys, the Leonida Straits run south-west of Key Lento. Borrachero Sound sits out on the west coast, just west of Port Gellhorn.

## GTA 6 Guides for Leonida's Shops, Stunt Jumps, Bars and Properties

The [GTA 6 wiki](/wiki/gta-6) is the main guide to the game.

Shops and services, stunt jumps, bars and nightclubs, and properties each have their own page: [stores and services](/wiki/gta-6/stores-and-services), [stunt jumps](/wiki/gta-6/stunt-jumps), [bars and nightclubs](/wiki/gta-6/bars-and-nightclubs) and [properties](/wiki/gta-6/properties).

Want to test what you know? The [GTA 6 quiz](/quizzes/gta-6) has 15 questions on Leonida, Vice City and the radio.

faq_json.q: Where can I get a printed copy of the Leonida map?
faq_json.a: Rockstar lists a printable Leonida map on its GTA VI media page. The [poster guide](/articles/gta-6-map-poster-how-to-get) explains how to get it.
The Leonida Keys are a tropical chain of islands in Mariana County, in the south of the state. That's the same county as Key Lento and Southwind.
Dalton Island is in Vice-Dale County, south-east of Vice City, near Gloriana Key.
